This file, when sourced by `makepkg --printsrcinfo`, will not perform any unintended actions beyond defining package metadata.
</details>

No scripts or executable logic are present in this file. The `noextract` directive is used appropriately for a libarchive-formatted skin file, and the options `!strip` and `!debug` are harmless packaging choices. All elements align with standard AUR packaging practices for a non-code asset like a theme.

The checksum for the archive is explicitly provided and not set to 'SKIP', indicating a pinned and verifiable source.

The build process uses `bsdtar` (from libarchive, listed in makedepends) to extract the skin files into the appropriate directory under `/opt/aimp/Skins`. These operations are typical for packaging prebuilt binary assets like themes or skins.

There are no network operations at runtime, no use of eval or obfuscated code, no unexpected system modifications, and no execution of downloaded content. The source URL, while using HTTP parameters, points to the official AIMP skin catalog and hosts only static asset downloads. All actions are confined to the package installation directory.
</details>
